name: handoff-autopilot
description: When a session has grown long, drafts the handoff for you from the session itself and hands you the prompt that starts the next one

atPercent.title: Offer a handoff at this context use (%)
atPercent.description: Once the context window is this full, one row above the prompt offers to draft a handoff. 0 turns the offer off; /handoff-draft still works.

file.title: Draft file
file.description: Where the draft is written, relative to the session's folder. It is overwritten each time, and never touches a HANDOFF.md of your own.
